meta.geom: sites[].g = polygons; each polygon = [exterior, holes...]; ring = delta ints x unit_km

AUDIT.rule: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-10-27, before any audit run. For each designated set G in {AT, AMB_DEG, ERP} and each null N in {size (area-decile + capacity +-5 %), ring (area-decile x centre-distance quintile + capacity +-5 %)}: one-sided empirical p in the harm direction, p = (1 + #{null at least as harmful as G}) / (R + 1), R = 999. Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05 over the 4 sets x 6 indices (dDI, dIso, dep_poor, dep_resid, conc_q5, opp) separately within each null. SEGREGATION-RISK if (dDI or dIso is BH-significant) in BOTH nulls. REAL-POTENTIAL if served demand per EUR (D_res_decent, else D_tau) >= null median AND opportunity index >= null median, in BOTH nulls. Label = risk / potential / both / neither. RIG is reported as context, not labelled.

data_status.real: parcels, PGT, DUSAF, census hex, IRPEF 2024 by CAP, OMI 2019-2024, ISTAT basket
data_status.assumption: FAR, yield, cost, tau, basket share, renter share, sigma, kappa, lambda
data_status.synthetic: archetype weight distributions (B); simulated households are a model, not records

criteria.label: Rent burden
criteria.unit: NIL OMI rent of 60 m2 / net income per taxpayer

AT.label: risk
AT.claim_it: Problema di collocazione solo a livello di sito (non significativo col null per blocchi di NIL), non un rischio di segregazione robusto. A FAR 1.0 la capacità AT (10,338 alloggi) ricade in NIL con reddito residuo -92 €/mese rispetto alla media cittadina (aree confrontabili -22 / -38); il 41 % è in NIL del quintile più alto di idonei ERP (confronto 18 / 18 %). Con il null per blocchi di NIL: reddito residuo p = 0.067, concentrazione p = 0.092. Si basa su 12 NIL (7.5 effettivi). ΔDI +0.00033 rispetto alle aree confrontabili (+0.4 % del DI di base): costruire lì desegrega un po' meno, non segrega. Etichetta pre-registrata 'risk'; null per blocchi dDI p = 0.103; stabilità nella griglia di sensibilità 0.14.
AT.claim_en: Placement concern at site level only (not significant under the NIL-block null), not a robust segregation risk. At FAR 1.0 AT capacity (10,338 dwellings) sits in NIL whose residual income is -92 €/month vs the city mean (matched land -22 / -38); 41 % of it is in top-quintile p_erp NIL (matched 18 / 18 %). NIL-block null: dep_resid p = 0.067 / 0.095, conc_q5 p = 0.092 / 0.198. It rests on 12 NIL (7.5 effective). ΔDI is +0.00033 vs matched land (+0.4 % of baseline DI 0.087): slightly less desegregating, not segregating. Pre-registered label 'risk' (dDI q 0.029 / 0.030); NIL-block dDI p = 0.103 / 0.102; grid stability 0.14.
caveats: NIL-level (88 NIL) and CAP-level (38 CAP) income: one ecological signal, not independent pieces of evidence.
Stephenson (92 households, CAP-imputed income) is neutralised by the 500-household floor; results without its AT sites are in numbers.without_stephenson.
The site-level null is anti-conservative when a set is concentrated in few NIL (test 1c); read the NIL-block null as co-primary.

AMB_DEG.label: neither
AMB_DEG.claim_it: Nessuna informazione. 5 siti in 5 NIL (348 alloggi): lo studio non ha potenza statistica per questo insieme.
AMB_DEG.claim_en: No information. 5 sites in 5 NIL (348 dwellings): the study has no power for this set.
caveats: Do not read 'neither' as evidence of absence.

ERP.label: potential
ERP.claim_it: Conveniente solo se il suolo è gratuito. L'etichetta 'potential' dipende dal suolo srv_erp valutato 1 €/m² (proprietà non verificata). Con suolo a prezzo di mercato: 1.32 famiglie servite per 1 M€ contro una mediana di 1.58 / 1.39 → nessuna etichetta. In valore assoluto serve 1,729 famiglie target contro 2,254 delle aree confrontabili. Indice di opportunità 0.590 (mediana 0.569).
ERP.claim_en: Cheap only if the land is free. Label 'potential' rests on srv_erp land at 1 €/m² (ownership not verified). Costed at market land: served per €1M 1.32 vs null median 1.58 / 1.39 → neither. In absolute terms it serves 1,729 target households vs 2,254 / 1,921 for matched land. Opportunity 0.590 vs null median 0.569 / 0.578. Concentration in top-p_erp NIL 26 % (matched 21 %).
caveats: srv_erp designation is not ownership; land cost is an assumption.
Served per € saturates for large sets, so it mostly tracks cost.

RIG.label: context
RIG.claim_it: Il segnale di collocazione più robusto (contesto, non un verdetto). Le aree degli ambiti di rigenerazione (855 siti, 53 NIL, 26.6 effettivi) stanno in NIL più poveri: +0.97 punti di contribuenti poveri (confronto +0.22), reddito residuo -68 €/mese (confronto -16).
RIG.claim_en: Most robust placement signal (context, not a verdict). Regeneration-zone land (855 sites, 53 NIL, 26.6 effective) sits in poorer NIL: +0.97 pp poor taxpayers (matched +0.22), residual income -68 €/month (matched -16); site-level p dep_poor 0.001, dep_resid 0.001.
caveats: RIG is 41 % of the non-designated pool, so its null is conservative.
Context only: not part of the pre-registered verdict.

people_vs_pgt.claim_en: Served target households, non-designated ('people') lens vs 'PGT as is': +48 % when it can choose freely from all non-designated land; +22 % against non-designated pools of the same size; +5 % when also ring-matched (PGT beats 2 of 6 pools). PGT's shortfall is mostly scarce, peripheral land.
people_vs_pgt.claim_it: Famiglie target servite, lente 'delle persone' rispetto a 'PGT così com'è': +48 % scegliendo liberamente tra tutte le aree non designate; a parità di dimensione del bacino +22 %; a parità anche di distanza dal centro +5 %. Lo svantaggio del PGT dipende soprattutto da aree scarse e periferiche, non da siti peggiori.

posthoc_changes: conc_q5 now uses the top quintile of p_erp only (the srv_erp arm made it partly tautological for ERP); the old OR definition is reported as conc_q5_or.
Placement indices (poor, for_, net_m, resid, q5 membership) use a household floor: NIL with < 500 households take the city mean (their income is CAP-imputed).
The null pool is all candidate land including G (permutation null), not non-designated land only (review 2 calibration fix).
The BH family is now the stated 4 sets (AT, AMB_DEG, ERP, RIG) x 6 indices; the first runs used 3 sets.
All p-values are one-sided in the harm direction (review1 said two-sided; config said one-sided). Two-sided p are in audit_indices.csv.
NIL-block permutation null added as a co-primary robustness check (reported next to the label, not part of the rule).
